premises.text: Cookie automates fresh multi-tray cooking with a robotic device controlled by a phone cook button
premises.evidence_span: Cookie delivers that same experience in making home-cooked meals with multiple trays of fresh ingredients

premises.text: Primary beachhead is college students who lack time, skill, and home-cooked meal access
premises.evidence_span: Now I'll be in college next year, along with 20 million other students in the U.S. We'll have limited time and ability to make food

premises.text: Hardware stack is tray storage/delivery, induction cooktop, and robotic stirring/manipulation
premises.evidence_span: a storage and delivery mechanism for food trays, a safe induction cooktop, and of course, the robotic arm

premises.text: Foodie app provides recipe store, scheduling, tips, progress, and chef-authored recipe teaching including motion tracing
premises.evidence_span: Chefs can also use Cookie to create recipes. It's not just about cooking food. Chefs can use Cookie to teach it how they cook

premises.text: Commercial offer is ~$4 fresh meals, free app, $600 device or rental subscription, priced vs mid-tier frozen meals
premises.evidence_span: Our meals compete on price with mid-tier frozen meals, but the difference is that our meals are made with fresh ingredients and real food

domains.name: Fresh meal pricing and device offer

value.text: Push-button home-cooked fresh meals for people who cannot cook conventionally
value.evidence_span: So why can't we cook by pushing a button?

causal_links.evidence_span: cook a recipe meal from a recipe database
made with fresh ingredients and real food

notes: Waste/health impact folded into commercial fresh-meal theory rather than separate domain this run.
